g.text: DP output table in native schema
• Seeds with Stage 1's 1-way marginals y_i (no re-measurement)
• Measures noisy clique marginals μ̃ (MST / AIM / SWIFT)
• Fits Markov Random Field p_θ(x) via Private-PGM mirror descent
• Reconciles noisy marginals into a consistent joint distribution
• Samples synthetic integer records via junction-tree elimination
